evidence.description: Report number 24-009779. Date of incident Wednesday, March 13, 2024; time not reported. Location given as the 3200 block of Kallin Avenue, Long Beach, CA. Premises type: residence. Police were called regarding a break-in.

The suspect posed as a salesman or service worker, knocked, and entered when the occupants did not appear to be home. The report states police describe this for every incident in the series and that it is not specific to this address, so it is not recorded as this incident's entry method.
Footage, vehicle, point of entry, damage, and items missing are all listed as not reported.
The report itself lists time of day, items taken at this address, loss value, entry force, and surveillance or doorbell footage as unknown.
